therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell proliferation and invasion pathways
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced estrogen/progesterone receptor-positive (ER+/PR+) or Her2/Neu-positive (Her2/Neu+) breast cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective response rate (complete response or partial response by RECIST criteria)

results.target_engagement_evidence: Pharmacokinetic data showed measurable plasma concentrations with peak levels at 1 hour post-dose (70mg: 107.09 ng/ml, 100mg: 77.21 ng/ml at Week 3)
biomarker_changes: Collagen Type IV increased 31.35% (70mg) and 36.67% (100mg) at Week 3
subgroup_findings: Her2/Neu-amplified tumors: 0% response rate (70mg), 11.11% response rate (100mg)
ER/PR-positive tumors: 3.23% response rate (70mg), 7.14% response rate (100mg)
results.dose_information: 70 mg twice daily or 100 mg twice daily, oral tablets, treatment duration average <6 months

context.duration: Treatment until progression or discontinuation, average <6 months, follow-up through Week 45
